title: NSFL: A Post-Training Neuro-Symbolic Fuzzy Logic Framework for Boolean Operators in Neural Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2604.10604v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Standard dense retrievers have no native mechanism for multi-atom logical constraints. We introduce Neuro-Symbolic Fuzzy Logic (NSFL), a training-free framework that brings fuzzy-logical structure to neural embedding spaces through a first-order finite-difference treatment of similarity. NSFL anchors logical operations on zero-order atomic scores while steering with Neuro-Symbolic Deltas (NS-Delta) -- the marginal semantic contributions induced by contextual fusion -- preserving atomic meaning while capturing contextual dependence, and avoiding the representation collapse and manifold escape endemic to geometric baselines. For latency-constrained deployment, Spherical Query Optimization (SQO) uses Riemannian optimization to project logical formulas into manifold-stable query vectors. Across six encoder configurations and two modalities, NSFL yields mAP@100 improvements up to +81% on QUEST and +70% on a COCO-derived text-to-imag

translated_title: NSFL：一种面向神经嵌入中布尔运算符的训练后神经符号模糊逻辑框架
translated_abstract: 标准稠密检索器缺乏处理多原子逻辑约束的原生机制。我们提出了神经符号模糊逻辑框架，这是一种免训练框架，通过对相似度进行一阶有限差分处理，将模糊逻辑结构引入神经嵌入空间。NSFL 将逻辑运算锚定在零阶原子分数上，同时通过神经符号增量进行引导——即由上下文融合所诱导的边际语义贡献——在捕获上下文依赖性的同时保持原子语义，并避免了几何基线方法中普遍存在的表示坍缩和流形逃逸问题。针对延迟受限的部署场景，球形查询优化（SQO）利用黎曼优化将逻辑公式投影为流形稳定的查询向量。在六种编码器配置和两种模态上，NSFL 在 QUEST 数据集上实现了高达 +81% 的 mAP@100 提升，在 COCO 衍生的文本到图像检索任务上实现了 +70% 的提升。
tldr: 提出免训练的神经符号模糊逻辑框架 NSFL，借助 NS-Delta 边际语义贡献与黎曼优化查询投影，使稠密检索器无需训练即可原生处理多原子布尔逻辑约束，检索性能最高提升 81%。
en_tdlr: NSFL is a training-free neuro-symbolic fuzzy logic framework that enables dense retrievers to natively handle multi-atom Boolean constraints via NS-Delta marginal semantic contributions and Riemannian query optimization, boosting retrieval performance by up to 81%.
